'''Rhax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. They worked for [[Unidentified smuggler (Free Zone)|another smuggler]] who considered them to be among the best of her associates.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" /> By [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Date" /> Rhax had [[Death/Legends|died]] while smuggling an item out of [[District 1327|Breaktown]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" /> on [[Zakuul]],<ref name="The Old World">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Old World}}</ref> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="The Old Ways of Zakuul">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Old Ways of Zakuul}}</ref>

Rhax's employer delivered the item to the one who had requested it, a [[Unidentified thug (Free Zone)|thug]] in the [[Free Zone]] [[Black market/Legends|black market]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" /> at the Wild Space [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]<ref name="Asylum">{{TORcite|type=codex|Commerce in the Free Zone}}</ref> [[Asylum]], who also had a high opinion of Rhax. The smuggler told the client that the item would cost him extra because of Rhax's death. The thug offered to give her enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for [[Whiskey/Legends|whiskey]] out of respect for Rhax, to which she replied that she wanted enough to purchase whiskey better than what could be found in the Free Zone.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rhax was mentioned in an ambient conversation in "Chapter VI: Asylum" of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', a [[2015]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" />
